human_summary: Two university students were killed when a Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) garbage truck struck their motorcycle in the Konapara area of Demra, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Reports dated 12 December 2025 consistently describe the collision as fatal, with the victims identified as Redwan and Apu. A classmate, Tausif, claimed they were returning home from a wedding event around 4:30am when the truck hit them, leaving them seriously injured [ev_031d7714f37e547d, ev_738d53c92c9d089d]. The location is consistently reported as Konapara, Demra, with map evidence showing a pin at Konapara and a broader Demra/Sarulia area; coordinates are representative gazetteer centroids, not exact crash points [ev_1d44c58721ec92c0, ev_244b71a7a2c0143a, ev_1eacca6cdb82b6ae]. The incident is reported by Dhaka Tribune, tbsnews.net, and The Business Standard, with the latter's social media post and associated image. While the exact time of the crash is given as around 4:30am only in a cited classmate's account, the date is consistently 12 December. No source provides a precise crash point or details on injuries. A social media comment by a reader suggests a broader pattern of reckless driving in the area, but this is not a reported fact [ev_bc4144b4e776d8ef]. The incident appears to be a single event; all reporting aligns on the key details.
